name: git-cliff
description: Installs git-cliff from SHA-512 verified upstream releases for amd64 and arm64 Linux containers (glibc or musl).

gitCliffVersion.description: Stable git-cliff version in x.y.z format, without a v prefix. Requires an upstream Linux musl archive and SHA-512 checksum.

installDependencies.description: Install Git, CA certificates, curl and archive/checksum tools using apt, apk, dnf, microdnf or yum. Disable only on pre-provisioned images.
